mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening consumer and business demand, triggering a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by both high payroll growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE), signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 100k and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles where FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
